description: This file defines data structures related to managing and reporting the status of skills within a certain workspace, including details about skill requirements, missing dependencies, installation options, and update results.

classes.name: SkillsStatusReport
classes.description: Represents a report of skills status within a workspace.

classes.name: SkillStatus
classes.description: Contains detailed status information for a specific skill.

classes.name: SkillRequirements
classes.description: Lists the requirements for a skill, such as binaries, environment variables, and configurations.

classes.name: SkillMissing
classes.description: Specifies missing dependencies or configurations for a skill.

classes.name: SkillStatusConfigCheck
classes.description: Checks if a particular configuration file or value satisfies expectations.

classes.name: SkillInstallOption
classes.description: Defines installation options for a skill.

classes.name: SkillInstallResult
classes.description: Represents the result of attempting to install a skill.

classes.name: SkillUpdateResult
classes.description: Indicates the result of updating a skill, including success status and configuration info.
